ideas.title: Investigating Excessive Use of Force by ICE Agents
ideas.description: This story would investigate the circumstances surrounding the shooting of Alex Pretti and examine the use of force policies and procedures within ICE.
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the shooting of Alex Pretti?
What are the use of force policies and procedures within ICE?
ideas.insight: The story would shed light on the need for greater transparency and accountability in law enforcement agencies, particularly when it comes to the use of force.
